notes.text: Rates roughly follow a curve of `3942x/(x+167)`.

children.text: Rates grow roughly linearly until ~167 turtles, where diminishing returns push rates to a ceiling of ~3942 turtle eggs/h.

notes.text: Rates are reduced by 45% if the player does not sleep through the night.
Remove piston for Sweet Berries, Pink Petals, Wildflowers, or Tall Flowers.
Potion includes fire resistance potions and water bottles.
Enchanted books, iron boots, and potions are not collected.
(1.17-1.19.4) Rates are reduced to 520/h and 700/h for 1 and 23 snow golems, respectively.
Rates are measured with Efficiency V and Unbreaking III enchantments.
Figure used the netherite variant, a 13500H at 4.2 GHz, Minecraft 1.21, Zulu 22, and Carpet xpNoCooldown.
The tests reduced the monument count without rearranging the Nether portals. Better portal positioning may reduce lag by distributing guardians evenly.
Items accumulate slightly in the looting chamber with four monuments and two bots, increasing lag.
